## History

Before answering his call to the ministry, Jonas spent a long time trying to pursue a different path. He graduated from [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and studied theology at St. [Columbia](../codex/places.md#columbia). During a summer spent taking charge of the [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) Mission Church, he earned the conflicted affection of fellow boarder [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 ch.Jonas P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_

## Relationships

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jonas--phil-gordon.md)

[Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) and Jonas are good chums who spend time together fishing, boating, and walking. Despite her initial conflicted feelings while Jonas was preaching at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point) as a theological student, Phil's affection for the earnest young man grew. Their relationship advanced to the point where they became engaged to be married.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), +6 more_
